dogecoin.text:
This was the first time Jamaica’s bobsledders had competed at the Winter Olympics in 12 years.
 
But $DOGE collapsed in the months following. The ‘joke crypto' with a heart of gold wouldn’t return to Jamaican-bobsled levels until 2017, before collapsing AGAIN until… @elonmusk. https://t.co/opaHICjEuH

Before the bobsled campaign, $DOGE traded for $0.0004 — but within three days had surged over 400% to $0.002.
 
“We raced back to my house to ensure we could get the best price for the donations in a form the team could actually use," said #Dogecoin Foundation's Liam Butler. https://t.co/b1U9q0qe4K

In 2014 — a half-decade before @elonmusk — #Dogecoin pumped 50% in one day for a very different reason: its community raised 26 million $DOGE to send the Jamaican bobsled team to the Sochi Winter Olympics.
 
Back then, 26 million DOGE fetched 35 $BTC, a sum worth about $30,000. https://t.co/KtIUIJvQUh
